{   "summary": "General situation: Over the past 30 days, global grains and oilseeds markets have remained broadly stable with no directional price shocks or margin expansions. Brazilian soybean export offers to China have tightened due to freight and phytosanitary certification risks, despite strong crush margins and improving soybean meal sales in China. Black Sea wheat prices have risen 5-7% month-on-month, supported by freight parity enabling exports to ASEAN countries. Bunge’s crush margins are under pressure as soybean input prices rise faster than soy oil and meal outputs, compounded by high leverage post-Viterra merger and uncertainty over the 45Z biofuel tax credit. What changed vs previous comparable period: This 30-day window shows increased market activity and price inflation in Black Sea wheat compared to the prior month, which had no notable reports. Brazilian soybean export offers have become more cautious, contrasting with previously more fluid supply. Bunge’s valuation and margin risk have emerged as a focal point, a new development not highlighted earlier. Actionable implications for trading/brokerage: Traders should monitor Brazilian soybean export availability closely, as supply-side caution may tighten CFR China offers further. Black Sea wheat remains a viable export route to ASEAN, with price momentum supporting bids. Caution is warranted on Bunge exposure due to margin compression risk and high debt levels. Broker desks note corn CIF offers in Tarragona at 241 EUR for April and sunflower bids at 301 USD CPT Marmara, indicating active positioning in grains and oilseeds. 

Key facts:
- Black Sea wheat FOB prices increased 5-7% month-on-month as of March 12, 2026.
- Brazilian soybeans priced at 662.9 USD/MT on March 14, 2026, with export offers to China limited by freight and phytosanitary risks.
- Bunge’s EV/EBITDA at 10x, highest in its peer group, with $12.2B debt post-Viterra merger as of March 18, 2026.
- Chicago USDA wheat prices remain above $600/MT, supporting regional price levels.
- Corn CIF offers at 241 EUR/MT for April shipments in Tarragona as of March 25, 2026.

Ціни на кукурудзу на експорті в порту Одеса демонструють незначне зростання, з торгів на рівні 224-228 USD/т у кінці березня, що свідчить про помірний попит. Соняшникова олія та соєвий шрот пропонуються за цінами близько 709 грн/т та 19700 грн/т відповідно, без суттєвих коливань. Порівняно з попереднім місяцем, коли даних не було, спостерігається активізація ринку з появою пропозицій і торгів. Відсутність суттєвих цінових шоків або негативних новин свідчить про відносну стабільність.
